newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash maize down, exporters uninterested.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash maize down, exporters uninterested.

text.p: Argentine cash maize closed mainly lower Monday in low volume at the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange, with trade sapped by exporter indifference, traders said.

FAS elevator maize was steady at $100 in Buenos Aires, but lost ground in other ports. Cash soybeans, dragged down by a plunging Chicago, lost $3 in Buenos Aires to $252. Sunflower seed prices slipped after soybeans, also in low trade, losing $2 in Rosario to $222.
